title: 问题解决后的储蓄咨询
purpose: 展示客服如何先确认当前服务问题已完成，再给客户提供有事实依据的产品说明。

steps.label: 接入后续咨询
steps.description: 建立客户和当前通话的业务上下文。

steps.label: 客户说明咨询目标
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Hi, thanks for helping me with my account last time. I have a question about automatic savings.
steps.description: 客户先说明咨询目标；服务正面反馈和 savings 主题同时进入 transcript。

steps.label: 客服邀请客户说明
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I’m happy to help. What would you like to understand about the savings rules?
steps.description: 客服让客户先明确目标，辅助分析等待更完整的上下文。

steps.label: 客户说明资金目标
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: I’m building an emergency fund, and I’d like something simple that I can adjust when my income changes.
steps.description: 客户补充个人目标，平台保留 savings 主题并等待业务状态确认。

steps.label: 客服确认产品问题范围
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: So you want an automatic rule that is easy to change, rather than a fixed commitment. Is that right?
steps.description: 客服复述客户目标，确保后续辅助与当前问题一致。

steps.label: 客户确认需求
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Exactly. I want to know how the rule works, what it costs each month, and how I can stop it if I need to.
steps.description: 客户明确询问产品事实和费用，平台可以准备检索批准的指导内容。

steps.label: 确认当前服务问题已完成
steps.description: 只有业务流程事件可以改变投诉权威，客户的积极表达本身不会自动解决问题。

steps.label: 客服确认进入产品说明
steps.speaker: AGENT
steps.text: I’ve confirmed there isn’t an open service issue to resolve on this call. I’ll check the approved savings details for you now.
steps.description: 当前服务状态已由业务流程确认，客服明确告诉客户即将查看产品事实。

steps.label: 客户提出具体问题
steps.speaker: CUSTOMER
steps.text: Yes, please tell me the monthly cost and what I need to do to get started.
steps.description: 客户的问题已经具体到产品费用和开始条件，触发后续辅助判断。

steps.label: 展示有依据的产品辅助
steps.description: 资格、产品事实、指导和解释校验通过后，客服才看到可选的后续方案。

steps.label: 客服桌面确认显示
steps.description: 记录浏览器已经应用当前完整辅助快照。

steps.label: 结束通话
steps.description: 结束实时会话并撤回实时辅助。

steps.label: 生成通话总结
steps.description: 保存客户诉求、情绪、主题和 evidence refs。

steps.label: 确认重复执行安全
steps.description: 再次执行同一 post-call job，不产生重复记录。
